chunks: God makes firm those who believe with the firm word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter, and He causes the wrongdoers to go astray, and God does what He pleases.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Qawl al-Thabit' (the firm word) in Surah Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Al-Thabit' (the Firm), referring to the Ahl al-Bayt or the Imams as the living embodiment of God's word that stabilizes the believer's faith. The 'firm statement' is understood not merely as doctrinal belief but as adherence to the divine authority established at Ghadir, ensuring stability in both the temporal world and the hereafter. This contrasts with the 'Zalimin' (wrongdoers) who, despite having knowledge, are led astray by their own arrogance and deviation from the truth.
